## Best choice in performance - RAIDER Series

 The worldwide leader in high-performance power supply unit manufacturer announces RAIDER Series Power Supply. It is one of the mainstream 80 PLUS® Silver certified, efficiency > 88% and it comes with the +12V single rail, SATA array cable design, MIA IC TM and POST SR (Post Synchronous Rectification). This new series of product features exclusive full-sleeves, black PCB, also meet 2013 ErP standard (Energy Related Product).The RAIDER series' 450/550/650/750 W models are made for overclocking players, hardware enthusiasts and DIY experts!

Fully compatible with 4th generation Intel Core Series processors

FSP's power supply provide 100% Compatible with Haswell CPUs.
